subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should ambient room_event runs use the safe non-owner owner-only Gateway tool inventory for every sender while keeping effective visible delivery message-tool-only?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but changing owner-sent room-event tool inventory and separating prompt-facing from effective delivery is a product and security-boundary policy choice.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Merge after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only tool inventory for every sender.

options.title: Accept Blocked-Visible Tools
options.body: Allow schemas to remain prompt-visible only after maintainers explicitly approve the boundary change and proof covers direct, deferred, and child-session execution paths.

options.title: Split The Tool-Cache Change
options.body: Continue the room-event prompt-mode forwarding separately while pausing the owner-only tool-surface change on the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only tool inventory for every sender.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient room-event policy history from the prior merged policy work.
